en: Kobe Bryant is the king of this court and he heard about your victories over the other guys here.  He is ready to challenge you to a game of winner take all, standard rules 1-on-1; first to 11 wins!

It's time to jump into the drills and challenges; let's get this ball rolling.  In order to make it to the EBC, you're going to need to get contacts from a lot of NBA players as well as some celebrities.  You'd better get going!

Grow your character's attributes here by successfully reaching the goal for each development drill. Playing the development drills will cost you development points which you earn by defeating the various challenges located within each city. We've started you off with a small handful of development points so you can hit the ground running.

Good luck out there!

Welcome to your Nike Shoe Locker.  Here is where you equip your player with your new Nike shoes.  Each shoe gives you special ability boosts, so make sure you are wearing the appropriate shoe for the appropriate situation.

Welcome to the EBC Tournament! Here you'll face off against some of the best street ballers in the country. Good luck!
Congratulations! You've made it to the final game of the EBC Tournament! But you can't relax now... there are still 21 points between you and the championship.
No one said it was going to be easy!  Lucky for you, there is another EBC Tournament right around the corner so get your team signed up right away.  Better luck next time baller...
